context_purpose: The court confirms that a summoned citizen is in the candidate pool for the day's selection session so the session can proceed lawfully.

norm_violation_today.reason: The court is the issuer and is entitled to the notice and ID; only copying by entrance security or contractors could exceed norms, which is a minor point.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The court must later call and seat candidates by name, so identity must be revealed inside the process; a token only covers the entrance.

transmission_check.reason: The court likely needs to record attendance of summoned persons for the selection procedure, and I cannot say whether a token would satisfy that.

context_purpose: A shelter programme allocates scarce subsidised beds to migrant workers who are lawfully in status or in a lawful transfer period.

norm_violation_today.reason: Asking for the termination letter and complaint records exposes dispute details beyond what a status check needs, though the NGO may have a social-assessment reason for some of it.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A status attestation cannot support the NGO's vulnerability prioritisation or funder reporting, which need the case story.

transmission_check.reason: The NGO is a voluntary programme with no stated legal duty to hold the case file, so a status attestation is not legally blocked.

context_purpose: The owners' committee counts one weighted vote per unit and prevents double counting at the meeting.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full title deeds, ID copies and a lobby-posted sign-in sheet expose address, mortgage and ID data to neighbours who only need unit and share.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: unit, share and uniqueness are what the vote count needs, though co-owner and proxy logic add complexity.

transmission_check.reason: The building management rules and bylaws probably require verifying ownership, but I cannot say whether they require document copies.

context_purpose: A temple camp organiser wants assurance to parents that volunteer helpers have no child-protection-relevant record.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID scans and an open-ended records consent are kept on a personal phone after camp ends, beyond the one-off check the purpose needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Almost nothing for the organiser; parents get the same yes/no, though a proof is less intuitive than a certificate.

transmission_check.reason: This is an informal safety check with no legal duty to keep the documents, so a proof does not conflict with any obligation I know of.

context_purpose: The hospital lets only approved adult companions stay overnight with children, to protect child patients.

norm_violation_today.reason: A paper list showing children's names, beds and guardians' names left on the counter discloses data to other families who have no need for it.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The guard still needs to match the person to an expected adult and nurses may recheck by face, so the proof removes only ID numbers and the visible list.

transmission_check.reason: Ward access control is a hospital safety policy, and a time-limited companion credential serves it as well as a list.

context_purpose: A partner library grants visitor borrowing rights only to patrons in good standing at their home library.

norm_violation_today.reason: The partner desk copies the ID and may see loan and fine history when only good standing is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: good standing is the decision; recourse for lost books would need identity, which a reciprocal agreement may require.

transmission_check.reason: Reciprocal borrowing is a voluntary service, so a signed good-standing credential should be acceptable if the consortium agrees.

context_purpose: The presale operator wants to keep brokers out and give each real fan-club member a single presale allocation.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID photo, selfie, address and a reused face template go well beyond a membership and one-redemption check.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Brokers can still register many fake accounts unless issuance is tied to a verified identity, so anti-scalping power depends on the issuer.

transmission_check.reason: No known duty forces the club to collect ID, so it can accept a membership proof if it chooses.

context_purpose: The event organiser confirms that each vendor holds a current food and stall permit on the event date.

norm_violation_today.reason: ID scans and permit copies sit in a loosely controlled shared folder held by a short-lived contractor beyond need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little: current permit status is the check, though the organiser may want records for dispute or audit.

transmission_check.reason: The organiser likely must verify permits and may have to keep application records, and I cannot say whether a signed status would satisfy either.
